claim_freeze.claim: 20 of 112 candidate tables are reachable by the completed name-pattern channel; 92 are UCD-only.
The eligibility layer yields 67 counted catalogues and 6,417 raw rows in the four frozen slices.
In 10 <= z < 11.5, the row sample contains 453 rows at any stored magnitude and 176 with stored muv <= -20; these are heterogeneous catalogue-native UV-like values without bandpass homogenization.
The target slice is provenance-dominated: J/A+A/704/A339/lephare supplies 420 of 453 rows and 161 of 176 bright rows; five other tables supply 33 rows.
No predefined-roster published-LF table met the machine-readable data requirements for 10 <= z < 11.5; this means missing extractable data, not zero galaxies or zero published LFs.

prohibited_implications: Do not call the 6,417 rows confirmed galaxies.
Do not imply that all 67 counted catalogues contribute rows; 27 contribute and 40 contribute zero in the frozen slices.
Do not present the 453 slice rows or 176 bright rows as independent across catalogues; one source table supplies 420 and 161 respectively.
Do not present the stored magnitude fields as a bandpass-homogenized 1500-angstrom M_UV measurement; the census is raw and the dominant table uses a UV-like catalogue field.
Do not imply that the frozen two-channel VizieR manifest exhaustively searches every public astronomy repository.
Do not call the row counts a luminosity function or density measurement.
Do not infer completeness, cosmic variance, survey disagreement, or catalogue selection from point density.
Do not say the census has only 176 rows in the slice; 176 is the M_UV <= -20 subset of 453 total rows.
Do not use the 453 denominator or six-table geometry in a public integration until Hwao independently verifies and publishes an audience-reachable supplement.
Do not describe missing machine-readable LF data as zero galaxies or zero published luminosity functions.
Do not use the faint-end alpha plot as evidence for the archival-gap result.
Do not imply journal acceptance, peer review, validation, or publication.
